title: apps/plugins control flow: Plugin install records vs synthesized Meta lookups
answers: How does apps/plugins work end to end?
Where does a GET on plugins.grafana.app/Meta get its data from?
How is the plugins app wired into the API server and background sync?
What is the difference between the Plugin kind and the Meta kind?
body:
apps/plugins exposes two kinds under plugins.grafana.app (apps/plugins/kinds/manifest.cue): `Plugin` (apps/plugins/kinds/plugin.cue) is a real CRUD install record {id, version, url?, parentId?}; `Meta` (apps/plugins/kinds/meta.cue) is full plugin.json/signature/module metadata, never stored (`search.endpoint:false` on both kinds) — synthesized per request.

Entry points:
- API: `pkg/registry/apps/plugins/register.go:ProvideAppInstaller` builds a `meta.ProviderManager` (apps/plugins/pkg/app/meta/manager.go:NewProviderManager, chaining CoreProvider + LocalProvider in order — first success wins, each Result carries its own TTL) and passes it to `apps/plugins/pkg/app/app.go:New`/`NewPluginsAppInstaller`. `InstallAPIs` (app.go) swaps default REST storage via `apps/plugins/pkg/app/storage_wrapper.go:customStorageWrapper`: `Meta`→`apps/plugins/pkg/app/meta_storage.go:NewMetaStorage` (read-only), `Plugin`→`apps/plugins/pkg/app/plugin_storage.go:newPluginStorage` (generic store + lifecycle hooks).
- Background sync: `pkg/services/pluginsintegration/installsync/syncer.go` (feature toggles `pluginInstallAPISync` + `pluginStoreServiceLoading`, per apps/plugins/README.md) calls `apps/plugins/pkg/app/install/registrar.go:InstallRegistrar.SyncNamespace` once per org namespace at startup to push on-disk plugins into the API.
- CatalogProvider (meta/catalog.go, calls grafana.com) and the `meta.Provider` interface exist but are NOT in the default chain built in register.go today — only Core+Local are wired.

Wiring: blank-imported in `pkg/extensions/enterprise_imports.go` (apps/plugins/pkg/apis/plugins/v0alpha1, .../pkg/app, .../pkg/app/meta, .../pkg/app/metrics, pkg/registry/apps/plugins) — same mechanism as other App-SDK apps.
applies: Describes apps/plugins specifically (its own Go module under apps/plugins/go.mod); other apps/* modules have their own separate control-flow maps.

API wiring in register.go:ProvideAppInstaller builds ProviderManager chaining CoreProvider + LocalProvider—first success wins, each result carries own TTL—and passes it to app.go:New; InstallAPIs swaps default REST storage for both kinds via storage_wrapper.go. Background sync via pluginsintegration/installsync/syncer.go calls InstallRegistrar.SyncNamespace at startup per org namespace to push on-disk plugins into API. CatalogProvider (meta/catalog.go, calls grafana.com) exists but is NOT wired in the default provider chain. All apps/plugins code blank-imported in pkg/extensions/enterprise_imports.go.
